interview.hardest_part: Executing precise platforming and combat from isolated screenshots using 0.4-second inputs, especially reacting to boss telegraphs, managing spacing, and healing without taking further damage.
interview.likely_failure: The run is most likely to stall around Moss Mother or another early combat/platforming gate, with repeated deaths and navigation backtracking consuming the time budget before the later bosses, dash, and economy milestones are reached.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Pausing while choosing actions allows deliberate planning; death preserves the run and saved progress; benches provide healing and respawns; silk rewards attacking with healing; and early exploration, enemy kills, currency, and character encounters offer incremental points.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Inputs are held blindly for a fixed interval while native simulation time can vary, making jumps, attacks, and dashes hard to time. Enemy knockback, hazards, limited health, silk management, boss patterns, and interconnected-room navigation can compound small execution errors into repeated deaths and substantial time loss.
